nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Default Vite + React template README describing the scaffold setup, available plugins (@vitejs/plugin-react using Oxc and SWC), React Compiler status, and ESLint configuration guidance.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Root HTML shell for the labConnect web SPA, loading Google Fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono, Instrument Serif), Leaflet map library from CDN, and Google Sign-In client, then mounting the React app via /src/main.jsx.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets lang='fr' for French locale. Leaflet CSS and JS are loaded from unpkg CDN with SRI integrity hashes for security.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Vite project manifest for the labConnect web frontend, declaring React 19 as the sole runtime dependency and configuring standard dev, build, lint, and preview scripts via Vite 8.
